annotations.text:
One real episode: seed USA, 400 days, ended infected_all.
Paused at day 326 — 76.8% infected, 18.6% dead, cure at 53.5%, DNA down to 1, 38 of 60 traits.
The curves, the map, the scrubber ticks and every row of the purchase history are real data
from the reference expert policy.

Two stand-ins: [MODEL] fills in once a real Mesocosm run exists, and the reasoning paragraph
is sample prose — no model has played this yet.

MAP
Brightness = how much of a country is affected.
Hue swings amber → crimson as more of the
affected have died.
A blue outline marks a country still under 70%
affected — at this frame that is Australia and
the arid belt, which the plague could not reach
until Heat Resistance 2 on day 214.

Caveat: the agent's observation carries no
per-country data. Driving this map from a real
model run needs that state added to the replay —
see the note in the chat.

PURCHASE HISTORY
Newest at the top, fading out at the bottom edge,
scrolls back through all 38 buys.

The shape of the list is the strategy: 20 traits
in the first 32 days, one at 160, one at 214,
then everything else after day 255.

B · EDITORIAL CASE STUDY — not taken.
The model's thinking set as the headline; numbers demoted
to a margin rail.
Tradeoff: the sim itself recedes — no strong sense of a
race against the cure.

C · BROADCAST REPLAY — not taken.
Scoreboard framing, video-player transport, commentary card.
Tradeoff: the loudest of the three, and the one most likely
to feel like style over substance if a run is uneventful.
